sentences.en: The detective took down his oral testimony on the spot.
sentences.zh: 侦探当场记录了他的口述证言。

sentences.en: During the first quarter we'll make two rounds of orals.
sentences.zh: 在第一季度我们将进行两轮口试。

sentences.en: We've got eyedrops and an oral antibiotic to give them.
sentences.zh: 我们有眼药水和口服抗生素可以给他们使用。

senses.zh: 口头的，口述的；口服的；属于或关于嘴的
